45079.notes: South Carolina tax sale with post-sale redemption. 04025.notes: Arizona tax LIEN certificate county (not an immediate deed). Unsold liens offered over-the-counter after sale. Separate Board of Supervisors Tax Deed Sales (Public Surplus) for properties that later forfeit to the state — not the same as the lien auction.

Internet-only; county does not register bidders in-office. Sold as-is under R&T Code; full payment and vesting within published Bid4Assets deadlines (often 48 hours historically on county FAQ).

06087.depositRules: Single $3,000 refundable deposit + $35 non-refundable processing fee to Bid4Assets by deadline (e.g. June 1, 2026 1:00 p.m. PT). Vesting information must be completed before deposit instructions unlock. Full payment by wire or certified/cashier’s check by settlement deadline (e.g. June 11, 2026). Default forfeits deposit.

06087.survivingLiens: A California tax deed conveys free of most liens existing before the sale, but federal tax liens survive (IRS 120-day post-sale redemption), as do taxes/assessments that become payable after the sale. Coastal Commission and special-district assessments need parcel-level review.
06087.quietTitle: Not a statutory prerequisite, but practically required — most CA title insurers will not insure a tax-deed property without quiet title (commonly 3–6 months, $3,000–$8,000+) or extended waiting after recording.
